jobs.description:
Looking for an active part-time job in the evening?

As a Logistics Associate at DHL, you will work together with your colleagues to ensure a smooth sorting process. You will process packages so they can reach their destination on time.

You can start as a Loader, where you place packages onto the conveyor belt, or as an Unloader, where you remove sorted packages from the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. As you gain more experience, you will have the opportunity to perform a variety of tasks within the sorting center.

You will work the evening shift, which starts between 4:30 PM and 5:30 PM and ends at 1:00 AM.

Packages can weigh up to 25 kg. If a package is heavier, you will always lift it together with a colleague.

- You are available 2 or 3 days per week, on Monday, Tuesday and/or Wednesday
- You speak Dutch or English
- You are at least 18 years old
- You live in or around Zwolle, Meppel or Kampen
- You have your own transportation (car, bicycle or scooter) or live within walking distance of the sorting center
- You are able to lift packages weighing up to 25 kg

Become a Reach Truck Operator at Rhenus Logistics. As a Reach Truck Operator, you are an essential part of our warehouse operations. You make sure stock is in the right place, order pickers have the materials they need, and the entire process runs smoothly and efficiently.

What will you do?

- - Operate the reach truck to pick items and replenish stock locations
- - Ensure order pickers receive the right materials on time
- - Keep an eye on the workflow and respond quickly when needed
- - Support your colleagues throughout the day
- - Help maintain a safe, organized, and efficient warehouse

Working hours:
Monday to Friday 07:00–16:00 or 08:00–17:00

Are you ready to take responsibility, work as part of a strong team, and make a real impact in a dynamic warehouse environment? Apply today and become part of the Rhenus team.

What we’re looking for:

- A valid reach truck certificate or relevant hands-on experience
- Full-time availability (40 hours per week) and a reliable, team-focused mindset
- Good English communication skills

jobs.description:
As an order picker at AS Watson in Heteren, you’re always on the move. You collect products using a voice pick system: your headset tells you where to go, you grab the right product, and confirm it. You walk a lot, lift small and large packages, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a 2- or 3-shift system, depending on your preference. This means sometimes you start early, sometimes later, but you always have time for yourself. In this role as warehouse worker or logistics employee, you really make an impact: thanks to you, thousands of people can shop daily at Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL.

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can handle physical work
- You’re available to work at least one Saturday every four weeks
- You choose either a 2- or 3-shift system
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren

Do you enjoy working with your hands and with different materials?

Composite material is made up of multiple materials bonded or laminated together. Think panels, interior parts, and structural aircraft components. As a Composite Shop Worker, you'll repair and maintain these parts. You're comfortable working with a range of materials: composite, plastic, metal, and interior materials. You carry out repairs according to fixed technical specifications and work instructions, working precisely with professional tools in a hangar or workshop environment. You'll also identify and resolve damage to interior and composite components, a role that combines the best of sheet metal work and interior work.

- You have experience working with different materials, or a relevant technical education (e.g. in sheet metal work, composites, or interior construction)

- You're willing to (further) build your technical expertise
- You speak good English (technical drawings are all in English)
- You're comfortable working with computers; administration is also part of the job
- You're willing to occasionally work evenings and weekends (on average once every 4 weeks - after 8 months from starting)
- Experience in car body repair, automotive interiors, or manufacturing work involving composite/plastic materials is a plus
